factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 25: 'Number of A-Shares: 3,731,465 (2024: 3,385,254)' and significant events: 'During the year, the Company was provided with capital through issues in January, March and August'

factual_claims.claim: Business growth was propelled by major commercial agreements, including expanded contracts with Win.Rocks AG totaling approximately 21 million kronor plus an additional December agreement of at least 15 million kronor over 24 months, a major agreement with HMM Deutschland estimated at 10 million kronor in 2025 and 30 million kronor in 2026, and an agreement with Sergel Kredittjänster, alongside strategic partnerships and the advancement of decentralized AI infrastructure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'During the year, the collaboration with Win.Rocks AG has grown to a total contract value of approximately SEK 21 million... In December 2025, a new agreement of at least SEK 15 million over 24 months was signed... On March 7, 2025, the Company communicated the volume of the agreement with HMM Deutschland, which is estimated at approximately SEK 10 million in 2025 and SEK 30 million in 2026... On May 22, 2025, an agreement was signed regarding AI services for document interpretation for Sergel Kredittjänster.' CEO statement: 'We have established a functioning technical platform, secured commercial agreements with recurring customers... Alongside our commercial progress, we continue to build our decentralized AI initiative... The next step is to take this model towards commercial deployment.'
